newsitem.title: USA: Oshman's Sporting sees closing 19 stores.
newsitem.headline: Oshman's Sporting sees closing 19 stores.

text.p: Oshman's Sporting Goods Inc said on Thursday it is accelerating closings of traditional stores and it expects to close a total of 19 stores this year, of which six are already closed.
Oshman's said it will continue expansion of its SuperSports USA stores concept and it expects to open four stores during the balance of the year.
SuperSports USA stores are expected to contribute 65 percent of total sales this year. Oshman's operates 129 sporting goods stores, including 27 large-scale stores, Oshman's said.
